description: Dated overview of a European data-centre market: how many data-centre projects of 500 kW or more our pipeline tracker lists and how many are permitted or being built, the stated MW by stage on each capacity basis, who develops the most of them, whether new grid connections are paused, rationed or conditional in that country, the grid carbon intensity and power price this hour, and how many data-centre rules apply.
